en.headline: Census office warns of fake population census website
en.dek: The Census and Statistics Department said a fraudulent site is circulating and has referred the matter to police; genuine contacts use only the 18 2026 hotline.
body: The Census and Statistics Department today urged the public to beware of a fake website impersonating the 2026 Population Census online service.

The department said the fraudulent address was circulating together with emails and text messages that claimed to come from the department and invited recipients to click a link and submit personal data. The department stated it has no connection with the site, the messages or the emails, and has referred the case to the police for investigation.

Anyone who has already provided information to the fake site should contact the police. The department reiterated that only sampled households receive a purple notification letter, that genuine telephone calls display the Census Hotline number 18 2026, and that genuine SMS messages use the sender ID “#C&SD”. The department does not ask for passwords, embed unsolicited hyperlinks, or request identity-card, bank-account or credit-card details.
Members of the public who encounter suspicious contacts are advised to call the Census Hotline 18 2026 or the 24-hour Anti-Scam Helpline 18222 operated by the police.

zh.headline: 統計處籲提防偽冒人口普查網站
zh.dek: 政府統計處指有虛假網址及冒認電郵短訊流傳，已交警方跟進；正式聯絡只會顯示18 2026或發送人「#C&SD」。
body: 政府統計處今日呼籲市民提防偽冒2026年人口普查網站的虛假網址。
統計處表示，有關虛假網址連同冒認由該處發出的電郵或短訊一併流傳，要求收件人透過超連結提供個人資料。統計處強調與該網址、短訊及電郵無關，並已把事件交警方跟進。
任何市民若曾向該網址提供資料，應聯絡警方。統計處重申，只有獲抽樣選中的住戶會收到紫色信封通知信；該處致電或發送文字短訊給香港境內住戶時，會顯示來電號碼18 2026或短訊發送人名稱「#C&SD」。統計處不會要求提交密碼，亦不會在非應要求而發出的電郵或短訊內載有網站連結，更不會索取身份證、銀行戶口或信用卡資料。
市民如懷疑遇到詐騙，可致電普查熱線18 2026，或警方24小時防騙易熱線18222。
